title: W9 A2 -- Hide the sidebar scrollbar and stop sideways scroll
description: Follow section '### A2 --' of docs/agent-work/2026-11-10-ui-wave-9/PLAN.md exactly, plus its 'Rules for every worker'. Verify: tests/w9-sidebar-scroll.spec.ts, scroll-fade and floating specs pass. Browser test port: PLAYWRIGHT_PORT=1432. No commits, no new packages, never run npm run build or a native screen script. Write the note docs/agent-work/2026-11-10-ui-wave-9/notes/A2.md.

review.note: Approved (agent-2ff3, W9 reviewer r2). Judged only the A2 hunks: src/styles.css .sidebar-groups -> overflow-x hidden, overflow-y auto, scrollbar-width none, plus ::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none } (other styles.css hunks belong to other tasks); src/components/ProjectSidebar.tsx drops 'isFloating &&' so watchScrollFade runs docked too. Stop rule checked: the fade CSS in src/components/scroll-fade.css is global ([data-scroll-top]/[data-scroll-bottom]), not under .is-floating, so the docked sidebar really shows the fade. New spec matches PLAN step 1 (1100x500, 25 sections, computed overflow-x/y and scrollbar-width, zero gutter, wheel scrolls). Fail-first A2-fail-first.txt: overflow-x 'auto', expected 'hidden'. Fresh runs (worker had not run these): npx tsc -b -> exit 0; npx vitest run src/components/scrollFade.test.ts src/sidebarPreferences.test.ts src/hoverEmphasis.test.ts -> 19/19 passed; PLAYWRIGHT_PORT=1432 npx playwright test tests/w9-sidebar-scroll.spec.ts tests/scroll-fade.spec.ts tests/floating.spec.ts --output test-results/T256-review -> 43 passed, 0 failed. Not checked: native WebKit (scrollbar hiding there is via ::-webkit-scrollbar; hand check in T278).
